REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 24, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

This section is reserved for comments related to Consent Calendar Items and items not listed on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council/Successor Agency. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the City Council/Successor Agency, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

8A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING A SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY POLICY MANUAL FOR USE AND REFERENCE BY WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION ENTITIES, IN CONNECTION WITH THE INSTALLATION OF A SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS, AND AMENDING THE CITY OF CERRITOS MASTER FEE SCHEDULE TO ADD A FEE FOR THE PROCESSING OF SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY PERMIT APPLICATIONS (COUNCIL).
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt AN URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 22.42, WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS, OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, ADDING A DEFINITION FOR A SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY AND CLARIFYING REQUIREMENTS AND REGULATIONS FOR SMALL WIRELESS FACILITIES, HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2019-3 (COUNCIL).*

*Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

11.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session
13.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
JANUARY 24, 2019, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by City of Cerritos Recreation Services
  Division Youth Basketball Pee Wee Division team - Spartans.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Mayor/Chair Mark E. Pulido

  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki was noted as having an excused
  absence for this meeting.

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Murali Vasudevan spoke regarding City program and service accomplishments
  in 2018.

  John Kilgore, Los Angeles County Sanitation Districts Supervising Engineer,
  spoke regarding labor negotiations and provided documents for the official
  record.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted
  by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  January 10, 2019 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Pulido

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration  to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION  OF
  THE  CITY  OF  CERRITOS  ADOPTING  A  SMALL  WIRELESS  FACILITY  POLICY
  MANUAL  FOR  USE  AND  REFERENCE  BY  WIRELESS  TELECOMMUNICATION
  ENTITIES,  IN CONNECTION  WITH THE INSTALLATION  OF A SMALL WIRELESS
  FACILITY IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS,  AND AMENDING  THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  MASTER  FEE  SCHEDULE  TO  ADD  A  FEE  FOR THE  PROCESSING  OF  SMALL
  WIRELESS  FACILITY PERMIT APPLICATIONS (  COUNCIL).

  Review  and consideration  to waive  full reading  of and adopt AN URGENCY
  ORDINANCE  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING  CHAPTER 22. 42, WIRELESS
  TELECOMMUNICATIONS,  OF  THE  CERRITOS  MUNICIPAL  CODE,  ADDING  A
  DEFINITION  FOR A SMALL WIRELESS  FACILITY AND CLARIFYING  REQUIREMENTS
  AND REGULATIONS  FOR SMALL  WIRELESS  FACILITIES,  HEREIN  REFERENCED  AS
  DEVELOPMENT  CODE AMENDMENT 2019- 3 ( COUNCIL).*

  Review and consideration  to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE
  OF  THE  CITY  OF  CERRITOS  AMENDING  CHAPTER  22. 42,  WIRELESS
  TELECOMMUNICATIONS,  OF  THE  CERRITOS  MUNICIPAL  CODE,  ADDING  A
  DEFINITION  FOR A SMALL WIRELESS  FACILITY AND CLARIFYING  REQUIREMENTS
  AND REGULATIONS  FOR SMALL WIRELESS  FACILITIES,  HEREIN  REFERENCED  AS
  DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT  2019- 3 ( COUNCIL).*

  Pursuant to Section  15061( b)( 3)  of the California Environmental  Quality Act
  CEQA),  this project is categorically  exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning  Manager, Robert A.
  Lopez, Current Planning Manager, and Tripp May, City' s  Wireless Technical
  Consultant.  A PowerPoint presentation  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Daisy Uy Kimpang, Verizon Wireless, expressed concerns regarding the Urgency
  Ordinance and Small Wireless Facility Policy Manual.

  John  Heffernan,  AT&T  External  Affairs  Team  Member,  expressed  concerns

  regarding the Urgency Ordinance and Small Wireless Facility Policy Manual.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  the public hearing and public comments.

  MOTION:  It was  moved  by Edwards,  and seconded  by Hu,  to:

  1.  Waive reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2019- 01, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE  CITY OF CERRITOS  ADOPTING  A SMALL WIRELESS  FACILITY
  POLICY  MANUAL  FOR  USE  AND  REFERENCE  BY  WIRELESS
  TELECOMMUNICATION  ENTITIES,  IN  CONNECTION  WITH  THE
  INSTALLATION  OF A SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY IN THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS,  AND  AMENDING  THE  CITY  OF  CERRITOS  MASTER  FEE
  SCHEDULE TO ADD A FEE FOR THE PROCESSING OF SMALL WIRELESS
  FACILITY  PERMIT APPLICATIONS ( COUNCIL);  and
 City of Cerritos  January 24, 2019
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  2. Approve Development Code Amendment 2019-3, a request to amend Chapter
  22.42, Wireless Telecommunications, of the Cerritos Municipal Code, adding a
  definition for a small wireless facility and clarifying requirements and
  regulations for small wireless facilities (COUNCIL); and

  3. Waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1023, AN URGENCY
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 22.42,
  WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS, OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPA
  CODE, ADDING A DEFINITION FOR A SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY AND
  CLARIFYING REQUIREMENTS AND REGULATIONS FOR SMALL
  WIRELESS FACILITIES, HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE
  AMENDMENT 2019-3 (COUNCIL); and

  4. Waive reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 1024, AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 22.42, WIRELESS
  TELECOMMUNICATIONS, OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE,
  ADDING A DEFINITION FOR A SMALL WIRELESS FACILITY AND
  CLARIFYING REQUIREMENTS AND REGULATIONS FOR SMALL
  WIRELESS FACILITIES, HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE
  AMENDMENT 2019-3 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

8B.  Review and consideration of a proposal by the ABC Unified School District to
  construct a parking lot at the Pat Nixon Elementary School property located at
  19600 Jacob Avenue in Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer.  A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Rene Navallo spoke in opposition to the proposed parking lot at Pat Nixon
  Elementary School.

  Carlos Borja spoke in opposition to the proposed parking lot at Pat Nixon
  Elementary School.

  Shanova Canada spoke in support of the parking at Pat Nixon Elementary
  School.

  Ji Won Su spoke in opposition to the proposed parking lot at Pat Nixon
  Elementary School.

  Dr. Tom Tracy, Principal of Pat Nixon Elementary School, provided additional
  information regarding the proposed parking lot.
 City of Cerritos  January 24, 2019

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8B.  (continued)

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor
  closed the public hearing and public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Yokoyama, to approve
  the ABC Unified School District’s proposed project to construct a parking lot at
  Pat Nixon Elementary School (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Solanki (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

  None.

10.  Legislative Items

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards, Hu, and Yokoyama, and
  Mayor Pulido.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 10:05 p.m.
